taskbody.context: The university’s annual Data Security Training is an easy way for employees to learn to identify and prevent cyberattacks. All employees, including student employees and unpaid appointments, must complete the training before Friday, Jan. 31, 2025.

step.cmd: Go to Reporter and select Unity ID Login.
Log in with your Unity ID and password.
Select Upcoming Events on the Courses and Events tile.
Select Access Online Content under the most recent NC State Data Security Training.
Select one of the Data Security Training modules.
Watch the video in its entirety and answer all of the questions.

taskbody.result: After you have watched the entire video and answered all of the questions, the course Moodle site should show that the course is completed. Please note that it can take up to 24 hours for the course completion certificate to be emailed to you. You can check the course completion status in Reporter by following the instructions at Have I completed the Data Security Training?
